verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.pt: Falou o Senhor a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, na tenda da revelação, no primeiro dia do segundo mês, no segundo ano depois da saída dos filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, dizendo:

verses.en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
verses.pt: Tomai a soma de toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, segundo as suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes de todo homem, cabeça por cabeça;

verses.en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.pt: os da idade de vinte anos para cima, isto é, todos os que em Israel podem sair à guerra, a esses contareis segundo os seus exércitos, tu e Arão.

verses.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.pt: Estará convosco de cada tribo um homem que seja cabeça da casa de seus pais.

verses.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, são os nomes dos homens que vos assistirão: de Rúben Elizur, filho de Sedeur;

verses.en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.pt: de Simeão, Selumiel, filho de Zurisadai;

verses.en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.pt: de Judá, Nasom, filho de Aminadabe;

verses.en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.pt: de Issacar, Netanel, filho de Zuar;

verses.en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.pt: de Zebulom, Eliabe, filho de Helom;

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.pt: dos filhos de José: de Efraim, Elisama, filho de Amiúde; de Manassés, Gamaliel, filho de Pedazur;

verses.en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.pt: de Benjamim, Abidã, filho de Gideôni;

verses.en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.pt: de Dã, Aizer, filho de Amisadai;

verses.en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.pt: de Aser, Pagiel, filho de Ocrã;

verses.en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.pt: de Gade, Eliasafe, filho de o Deuel;

verses.en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.pt: de Naftali, Airá, Filho de Enã.

verses.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.pt: São esses os que foram chamados da congregação, os príncipes das tribos de seus pais, os cabeças dos milhares de Israel.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
verses.pt: Então tomaram Moisés e Arão a esses homens que são designados por nome;

verses.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.pt: e, tendo ajuntado toda a congregação no primeiro dia do segundo mês, declararam a linhagem deles segundo as suas familias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, cabeça por cabeça;

verses.en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.pt: como o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim este os contou no deserto de Sinai.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Os filhos de Rúben o primogênito de Israel, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Rúben eram quarenta e seis mil e quinhentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Simeão, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes, cabeça por cabeça, todo homem de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Simeão, eram cinqüenta e nove mil e trezentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Gade, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair a guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Gade, eram quarenta e cinco mil seiscentos e cinqüenta.

verses.en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Judá, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair a guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Judá, eram setenta e quatro mil e seiscentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Issacar, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair a guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Issacar, eram cinqüenta e quatro mil e quatrocentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Zebulom, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair a guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Zebulom, eram cinqüenta e sete mil e quatrocentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de José: dos filhos de Efraim, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Efraim, eram quarenta mil e quinhentos;

verses.en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: e dos filhos de Manassés, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Manassés, eram trinta e dois mil e duzentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Benjamim, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Benjamim, eram trinta e cinco mil e quatrocentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Dã, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Dã, eram sessenta e dois mil e setecentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Aser, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o numero dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Aser, eram quarenta e um mil e quinhentos.

verses.en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Naftali, as suas gerações, pelas suas famílias, segundo as casas de seus pais, conforme o número dos nomes dos de vinte anos para cima, todos os que podiam sair a guerra,

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.pt: os que foram contados deles, da tribo de Naftali, eram cinqüenta e três mil e quatrocentos,

verses.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.pt: São esses os que foram contados por Moisés e Arão, e pelos príncipes de Israel, sendo estes doze homens e representando cada um a casa de seus pais.

verses.en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.pt: Assim todos os que foram contados dos filhos de Israel, segundo as casas de seus pais, de vinte anos para cima, todos os de Israel que podiam sair à guerra,

verses.en: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.pt: sim, todos os que foram contados eram : seiscentos e três mil quinhentos e cinqüenta.

verses.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.pt: Mas os levitas, segundo a tribo de e seus pais, não foram contados entre eles;

verses.en: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: porquanto o Senhor dissera a Moisés:

verses.en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.pt: Somente não contarás a tribo de Levi, nem tomarás a soma deles entre os filhos de Israel;

verses.en: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.pt: mas tu põe os levitas sobre o tabernáculo do testemunho, sobre todos os seus móveis, e sobre tudo o que lhe pertence. Eles levarão o tabernáculo e todos os seus móveis, e o administrarão; e acampar-se-ão ao redor do tabernáculo.

verses.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.pt: Quando o tabernáculo houver de partir, os levitas o desarmarão; e quando o tabernáculo se houver de assentar, os levitas o armarão; e o estranho que se chegar será morto.

verses.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Israel acampar-se-ão, cada um no seu arraial, e cada um junto ao seu estandarte, segundo os seus exércitos.

verses.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.pt: Mas os levitas acampar-se-ão ao redor do tabernáculo do testemunho, para que não suceda acender-se ira contra a congregação dos filhos de Israel; pelo que os levitas terão o cuidado da guarda do tabernáculo do testemunho.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.pt: Assim fizeram os filhos de Israel; conforme tudo o que o Senhor ordenara a Moisés, assim o fizeram.
